transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Well, I guess what finally made me come in is… I’ve been having a harder time keeping my attention where it needs to be. It’s not like I’m trying to be careless or anything, but over the last few months my mind keeps jumping around — like every CB chirp, a fuel price sign, some new idea that pops into my head — and then I miss little details I normally wouldn’t.

Like a client’s delivery note, or who I said I’d call back. I don’t want to make it sound worse than it is, but it’s been enough that I thought I should probably talk to somebody, if that makes sense.
Have you noticed yourself feeling more restless or hyperactive lately, like you can't sit still or you're always 'on the go'?

Yeah… a little, I guess. I wouldn’t say I’m bouncing off the walls or anything, but I do seem to keep making more work for myself.

Like I’ll rewrite route plans when they’re probably already fine, or check in on newer drivers after hours, or start fixing little things around the house. If I sit too long, I get kind of antsy, like I should be doing something useful. I don’t know if that counts as “on the go,” but that’s probably the best way I’d put it.
Have you noticed any changes in your mood lately, like feeling down, hopeless, or losing interest in things you usually enjoy?

Not so much down or hopeless, no. If anything, it’s kind of the opposite sometimes… for months I’ve been feeling really fired up, like everything’s going to work out and I can handle whatever comes up.

But then, uh… I don’t love admitting this, I’ve also been snapping over small stuff at home or out in the yard. Things that normally wouldn’t get under my skin. It’s not constant or anything, but it’s enough that my family’s noticed. Does that answer what you mean?
Have you noticed that you need less sleep than usual, like feeling rested after only a few hours of sleep or not feeling tired when you used to?

Yeah… I mean, I have noticed that. I didn’t want to make too big a deal of it, because I still feel okay during the day, but most nights I’m probably only sleeping three or four hours.

Then I’m up before daylight and I feel ready to roll, not really worn out like I’d expect. Is that the kind of thing you mean?

Have you found yourself starting lots of new projects or pushing yourself to get more done than usual — like taking on extra responsibilities at work or home, or feeling like you have to keep moving all the time?

Yeah… I guess I have, though I don’t want to make it sound like I’m trying to be some kind of hero or anything.

I just keep finding extra things to do. At work I’ll redo route plans even when they’re probably already fine, or I’ll check in on the newer drivers after hours just to make sure they’re good. At home it’s little repairs or chores I suddenly decide need doing.

If I sit still too long, I get kind of antsy, like I’m wasting time or I should be useful somehow. I don’t know if that’s what you mean by taking on too much, but… yeah, more than usual, probably.
